recognize_zh: 周邊血液的大顆粒淋巴球（LGL）細胞質中除了細小嗜天青顆粒外，還有較大的粉紅至紫色棒狀或圓形包涵體；電子顯微鏡證實為巨大的平行管狀陣列（parallel tubular arrays），見於 T-LGL 白血病。
features: Upper panels (PB): medium-to-large lymphocytes with round nuclei, condensed chromatin and abundant pale blue cytoplasm
Cytoplasm contains distinct, larger-than-usual pink-purple rod-shaped or globular inclusions in addition to fine azurophilic granules
Inclusions are few per cell and located near the nucleus or cell periphery
Lower panel (TEM): cytoplasmic stacks of long parallel tubular structures forming a giant parallel tubular array, adjacent to dense granules
Scale bar 10 µm; background red cells unremarkable
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows lymphocytes with moderate to abundant pale blue cytoplasm, round nuclei with condensed chromatin, and conspicuous large pink-purple rod-like to globular cytoplasmic inclusions in addition to fine azurophilic granules, consistent with large granular lymphocytes. Transmission electron microscopy of one such cell demonstrates an elongated bundle of densely packed parallel tubules (a giant parallel tubular array) alongside electron-dense granules. In a patient with rheumatoid arthritis and cytopenias, findings are consistent with T-cell large granular lymphocytic leukemia with prominent parallel tubular arrays; clonality should be confirmed by flow cytometry (CD3+CD8+CD57+) and TCR gene rearrangement or STAT3 mutation analysis.

ddx.vs: Reactive LGLs are polyclonal and transient without persistent cytopenias; morphology overlaps and clonality testing is needed.

ddx.dx: Chronic lymphoproliferative disorder of NK cells
ddx.vs: NK-LGL proliferations are surface CD3 negative, CD16/CD56 positive and lack TCR rearrangement despite similar granular morphology.
CHS shows giant fused granules in all granulocytes and lymphocytes with albinism and immunodeficiency, and the inclusions are enlarged lysosomes rather than tubular arrays on EM.
Alder-Reilly granules are dense metachromatic mucopolysaccharide granules in neutrophils and other leukocytes in mucopolysaccharidoses, not rod-shaped inclusions restricted to LGLs.
